title: Service Optimization Specialist
description:
Transport is at the core of modern society. Imagine using your expertise to shape sustainable transport and infrastructure solutions for the future. If you seek to make a difference on a global scale, working with next-gen technologies and the sharpest collaborative teams, then we could be a perfect match.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* We are seeking a dynamic and future-ready Invoice & Cost Control professional to lead financial governance, transport cost control, analytics, and digital transformation activities within Service Operations & Technology (SO&T).
* This role goes beyond traditional invoice processing—it combines financial control, data analytics, digitalization, process optimization and cost intelligence to enable accurate, efficient, compliant, and data-driven transport operations.
* As a key member of the Service Operations & Technology (SO&T) team, you will play a critical role in end-to-end logistics invoice validation, payment governance, transport cost control, GST compliance, financial reporting, supplier reconciliation, and analytics. You will leverage digital tools and data-driven insights to identify cost leakage, improve process performance, strengthen controls, and support sustainable business growth.

**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Financial Control & Governance**

* Ensure compliance with Internal Control (IC) processes for Logistics Service Provider (LSP) invoice processing and payment.
* Ensure LSPs submit invoices on time, accurately, and in compliance with statutory and tax requirements.
* Validate invoices using the 3-Way Matching Principle and ensure appropriate financial controls are maintained.
* Ensure all mandatory supporting documents are uploaded and maintained in SAP before invoice processing.
* Record, monitor, analyze, and resolve invoice disputes by coordinating timely escalations with LSPs and relevant stakeholders.
* Reconcile outstanding supplier statements of accounts within agreed timelines and obtain No Due Certificates (NDC) from LSPs.
* Ensure compliance with GST regulations through GST reconciliation, exception analysis, and timely resolution of discrepancies.

**Cost Management & Business Performance**

* Collaborate with Transport Controllers and Business Control teams to ensure accurate monthly provisions, accruals, freight costs, and transport volumes.
* Analyze transportation costs, premium freight, rush shipments, accessorial charges, and other cost deviations to identify cost leakage and improvement opportunities.
* Perform variance analysis, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, and cost-driver analysis to support business decision-making.

**Data Analytics & Digital Transformation**

* Act as a data-driven finance and cost-control partner, using analytical methods to identify trends, anomalies, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Develop and maintain interactive dashboards and management reports using digital reporting platforms.
* Combine financial, invoice, transport, supplier, and operational data to provide end-to-end cost and performance insights.
* Participate in digital transformation projects from process assessment and requirements definition through implementation, testing, adoption, and benefits realization.

**Strategic Projects & Cost Improvement**
The role will take ownership of strategic and time-bound projects based on business priorities, with a strong focus on cost optimization, analytics, and financial improvement.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities Include**

* Lead freight cost analysis and benchmarking across Group companies and operating companies to identify cost drivers, performance gaps, and opportunities for cost optimization
* Analyze dealer pricing versus actual/average transportation costs to identify price variances, under-recovery, negative margins, and potential financial losses, and recommend actions to improve cost recovery and avoid recurring losses.
* Group Company Price Analysis for Common Parts, Analyze pricing of common parts across Group Companies to identify significant price variations and cost drivers.
* Track project progress, financial impact, and benefits realization, ensuring agreed actions are implemented and improvements are sustained.

**Critical Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of financial controls, invoice validation, accounting processes, logistics operations, and transport cost management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to interpret large and complex datasets.
* Ability to perform variance analysis, trend analysis, root-cause analysis, forecasting, and cost-driver analysis.
* Strong understanding of data visualization, KPI management, and management reporting.
* Digital mindset with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, AI, analytics, and process digitalization.
* Strong knowledge of GST compliance, statutory requirements, monthly closing, accruals, and audit support.
* Ability to translate data and analytical outputs into business insights and actionable recommendations.
* Ability to lead and influence digital and process transformation initiatives in a changing environment.
* Strong ownership, attention to detail, and ability to balance speed, accuracy, compliance, and business value.

**Digital & Data Skills**

* ERP systems
* Power BI/Microsoft 365
* Data visualization and dashboard development
* Data extraction, transformation, and analysis
* Automated reporting and workflow solutions
* Understanding of RPA and intelligent automation
* Exposure to process mining and digital process optimization
* Basic understanding of data governance and data quality principles

**Qualifications**
University degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or Business Management.
  
  

* 3- 5 years of relevant experience in finance operations, logistics finance, transport accounting, invoice processing, or shared services.
* Experience with ERP systems such as SAP (Finance/Logistics modules)
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 (especially Excel), Power BI, QlikView/Qlik Sense, and other data visualization tools.

We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.
  
  
**Who We Are And What We Believe In**
We are committed to shaping the future landscape of efficient, safe, and sustainable transport solutions. Fulfilling our mission creates countless career opportunities for talents across the group’s leading brands and entities.
  
  
Applying to this job offers you the opportunity to join
**Volvo Group**
. Every day, you will be working with some of the sharpest and most creative brains in our field to be able to leave our society in better shape for the next generation. We are passionate about what we do, and we thrive on teamwork. We are almost 100,000 people united around the world by a culture of care, inclusiveness, and empowerment.
  
  
**Trucks Technology & Industrial Division**
hire team players who are ready to create real customer impact. Our decentralized teams work close to our customers, with speed and autonomy, to build what they truly need.
  
  
Join us to collaborate on innovative, sustainable technologies that redefine how we design, build, and deliver value. Bring your curiosity, your expertise, and your collaborative energy, and together, we’ll turn bold ideas into tangible solutions for our customers and contribute to a more sustainable tomorrow.

title: Financial Accountant
description:
**Job Title: Accountant**

**Position Summary**

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Accountant with at least two years of professional experience to join our growing finance team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing day-to-day accounting operations, maintaining accurate financial records, and assisting with month-end and year-end closing processes. The ideal candidate possesses strong technical accounting skills, a solid understanding of standard accounting principles, and the ability to work collaboratively with our team onsite.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Maintain and reconcile general ledger accounts, bank statements, and monthly expenses.

\* Prepare and process accurate journal entries for monthly, quarterly, and annual closings.

\* Assist in the preparation of monthly financial statements, including balance sheets, income statements, and cash flow statements.

\* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable processes, ensuring timely billing and collections.

\* Support payroll administration and verify expense reports for compliance with company policy.

\* Conduct variance analysis to identify and explain discrepancies between budgeted and actual figures.

\* Assist with tax preparation, regulatory filings, and external audit requests.

\* Collaborating with cross-functional teams to improve internal accounting controls and streamline processes.

**Qualifications and Skills**

\* Bachelor degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.

\* 1+ years of proven experience working as an accountant or in a similar financial role.

\* Solid understanding of accounting principles, practices, standards, and laws.

\* Proficiency in accounting software, such as QuickBooks, NetSuite, Tally, or Xero.

\* Advanced skills in Microsoft Excel, including VLOOKUPs, pivot tables, and data analysis formulas.

\* Exceptional attention to detail, organizational skills, and a high degree of accuracy.

\* Strong written and verbal communication skills to explain financial data clearly to non-finance teams.

title: Costing Lead - Capex
description:
**About The Business**
Tata Electronics Private Limited (TEPL) is a greenfield venture of the Tata Group with expertise in manufacturing precision components.
  
  
Tata Electronics (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tata Sons Pvt. Ltd.) is building India’s first AI-enabled state-of-the-art Semiconductor Foundry. This facility will produce chips for applications such as power management ICs, display drivers, microcontrollers (MCUs), and high-performance computing logic, addressing the growing demand across automotive, computing and data storage, wireless communications, and artificial intelligence markets.
  
  
Tata Electronics is a subsidiary of the Tata Group, which operates in more than 100 countries across six continents, with the mission to improve the quality of life of the communities it serves globally through long-term stakeholder value creation based on leadership with trust.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own capex architecture and investment planning activities across customer bid opportunities, ensuring solutions are technically and commercially optimized.
* Lead the assigned bid workstream, integrate subject matter expert inputs, and present recommendations during management review and approval gates.
* Develop bottom-up should-cost models for equipment, tooling, automation, manufacturing infrastructure, and supporting capital investments.
* Perform scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, and investment trade-off studies to support strategic bid decisions.
* Conduct make-versus-buy evaluations, including technical, operational, and financial assessments supported by NPV, IRR, and payback analysis.
* Review and approve the technical basis of estimate prior to submission into proposal costing and bid management processes.
* Review RFQs, customer specifications, drawings, BOMs, standards, and technical data packages to identify gaps, risks, assumptions, and clarification requirements.
* Develop structured customer clarification lists and convert incomplete RFQ inputs into explicit assumptions, dependencies, exclusions, and closure actions.
* Define workstream solutions, basis of estimates, implementation approaches, assumptions, risks, mitigation plans, and technical dependencies.
* Develop estimates for quantities, cycle times, resource loading, equipment and tooling requirements, NRE, capex, lead times, and implementation milestones.
* Assess equipment sourcing strategies and evaluate lead-time exposure for both standard and custom-built manufacturing equipment.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Capital expenditure planning, equipment investment strategy, and manufacturing infrastructure cost modeling.
* Development of bottom-up should-cost models for manufacturing equipment, automation systems, tooling, fixtures, and production assets.
* Financial evaluation techniques including NPV analysis, IRR calculations, payback analysis, return-on-investment assessment, and business case development.
* Scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, investment trade studies, and make-versus-buy decision frameworks.
* RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability management.
* Bid strategy development, proposal governance, solution storytelling, executive presentations, and customer clarification management.
* Integrated planning, RAID management, risk assessment, change management, and configuration control.
* Commercial evaluation of cost structures, schedules, contractual obligations, lead-time risks, and investment decisions.
* Equipment sizing, manufacturing capacity planning, resource loading analysis, cycle-time calculations, and implementation scheduling.
* Supplier evaluation, quotation analysis, sourcing strategy development, and technical-commercial recommendation preparation.
* Experience with ERP systems, PLM platforms, BOM management, document repositories, and controlled bid content environments.
* Strong analytical, financial modeling, structured problem-solving, and evidence-based decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and customer presentation skills.
* Proven capability to lead multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, quality, sourcing, finance, supply chain, and supplier organizations.
* Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to consistently deliver high-quality outputs against fixed bid deadlines.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline preferred.
* 10-15 years of relevant experience in costing, capital expenditure planning, bid management, manufacturing industrialization, NPI, engineering, or related functions within EMS or complex manufacturing environments.
